feeds.title: Ixchel Angora Bunny & Funky Fibre Art
feeds.description: Ixchel is an Australian Fibre Farm in the Yarra Valley in Victoria, breeding their own fluffy animals pesticide free and organic. Charly McCafferty (Ixchel Bunny) does all the spinning, dyeing, knitting and weaving and loving every second of it.

feeds.title: Full Moon Fiber Art
feeds.description: This site is about the fiber art, which I make and sell: quilts, potholders, wallhangings and other art. In my blog Wulf Howling I write about how I make my art and about what inspires me.

feeds.title: CENTERING WITH FIBER
feeds.description: A blog about Saori hand weaving,sewing clothing from hand wovens and many fiber arts from felting to hand spinning to fiber dyeing.

feeds.title: TextileArtist.org
feeds.description: TextileArtist.org is a place for textile and fiber artists to promote their work, be inspired and connect with like-minded creatives. Subscribe to get latest articles from this blog.

feeds.title: slowly she turned » fiber art
feeds.description: I am entranced with things that go unnoticed, the magical spaces between yarns and branches, the movement of mountains to sand, and dictionaries. I will update you with my posts about Fiber art.

feeds.title: Daisy Hill Studio Blog
feeds.description: I am a fiber craft person working in the crochet/felting/freeform style and including mixed media and freeform in my designs. Took up crocheting when I was 17 and never put the hook down. Never one to follow patterns after learning the basics, I have spent a lifetime exploring thread, yarn, and fibers that could be wrapped around my hooks.

feeds.title: Blue Sky Fibers
feeds.description: Blue Sky Fibers started as a pet project, of sorts. Shortly after graduating college, owner/founder Linda Niemeyer's curious preoccupation with Alpacas led to her buying one. Follow her blog to explore our expanding collection of natural fibers and patterns designed to inspire, excite and delight an ever-growing community of knitting enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Clara Nartey Blog
feeds.description: The home of creativity and textile art business where textile artists supercharge their creativity, learn new techniques and grow their businesses

feeds.title: Surface Design Association Blog
feeds.description: As a nonprofit, member-driven organization, our mission is to promote awareness and appreciation of textile-inspired art,innovation in Fiber art and design through publications, exhibitions, and conferences.

feeds.title: Greater Birmingham Fiber Guild
feeds.description: We are a group of fiber enthusiasts from Birmingham, Alabama who meet at least once a month to knit, crochet, tat, bobbin lace, weave, spin, felt, dye, talk about and play with fiber.

feeds.title: Duluth Fiber Handcrafters Guild
feeds.description: The members gather together for learning and fellowship in appreciation of the fiber arts. Join us and explore weaving, spinning, dyeing, knitting, basketry, felting, beading and other allied crafts.

feeds.title: Tanis Fiber Arts Blog
feeds.description: Tanis Fiber Arts produces high quality hand dyed yarns. Our custom spun, eco-friendly, organic, washable wool line of yarns. Available in Fingering, DK, Worsted and Chunky weights.

feeds.title: Lauren Williams Blog
feeds.description: As a self-taught painter,the six foot wide, dip-dyed tapestry was an overnight motivator to begin offering custom fiber art to friends and family.

feeds.title: Art and Quilts, cogitations thereon
feeds.description: Elizabeth Barton loves learning: art (watercolor), music (piano), psychology and I have a weird sense of humor, great curiosity and determination. Keep up with the articles from Elizabeth Barton by following this feed.

feeds.title: Lynda Shoup | Fiber Art
feeds.description: Lynda Shoup is a mixed media fiber artist who makes art journals, collage, handmade books, hand spun yarn, needlework and printing.

feeds.title: Fiber Art Network Blog
feeds.description: The Fiber Art Network is a community organization in support of fiber artists, collectors, enthusiasts, and leaders in the fiber art and textiles community.
